connectors.name: Type 2 AC
connectors.description: AC charging at 380-415 V; Annexure II lists Type-2 AC for 4W, 3W and 2W.

connectors.name: Bharat DC-001
connectors.description: Low-voltage DC charger (15 kW). Annexure II lists the 48 V variant for 4W, 3W and 2W, and the 72 V-or-higher variant for 4W; the BEE data does not say which variant.

connectors.name: Bharat AC-001
connectors.description: 230 V AC charger with three 3.3 kW guns (10 kW total); Annexure II lists it for 4W, 3W and 2W.

connectors.name: Light EV AC charge point
connectors.description: Light EV AC charge point up to 7 kW (charging device IS-17017-22-1, socket IS-60309). Annexure III lists light-EV charge points separately from parking-bay (car) charge points.

connectors.name: Light EV DC charge point
connectors.description: Light EV DC charge point up to 7 kW (charging device IS-17017-25, vehicle connector IS-17017-2-6). The BEE data also lists an IS-17017-2-7 connector variant.
